With a wide range of flexible, distinctively appointed banquet and meeting space, The Grand graciously accommodates groups of all sizes and set-ups. Our talented and experienced team oversees every detail of your corporate event - from menu selection to decor to transportation and audio/visual needs. You can be assured when you choose The Grand for your next corporate event, you are working with a trusted business partner; someone who intimately understands the importance of service and image.
